description: memory-gap-surface.py — Stop hook that surfaces uncaptured external IDs (H1), reference_*.md files absent from MEMORY.md (H2), and COMPLETED items lacking memory writes (H3). Also auto-indexes untracked reference files (stub only).

test_cases.label: exits 0 silently on clean state (no gaps)
test_cases.command: mkdir -p /tmp/mgs_clean/.claude/projects/-Users-viresha-gokul-os/memory && echo '# Memory Index' > /tmp/mgs_clean/.claude/projects/-Users-viresha-gokul-os/memory/MEMORY.md && HOME=/tmp/mgs_clean python3 ~/gokul-os/.claude/hooks/memory-gap-surface.py <<< '{}'; echo exitcode=$?

test_cases.label: H2: detects reference_*.md absent from MEMORY.md index
test_cases.command: mkdir -p /tmp/mgs_h2/.claude/projects/-Users-viresha-gokul-os/memory && echo '# Memory Index' > /tmp/mgs_h2/.claude/projects/-Users-viresha-gokul-os/memory/MEMORY.md && touch /tmp/mgs_h2/.claude/projects/-Users-viresha-gokul-os/memory/reference_test_engagement.md && HOME=/tmp/mgs_h2 python3 ~/gokul-os/.claude/hooks/memory-gap-surface.py <<< '{}'
expected_stdout_contains: reference file not in MEMORY.md index

test_cases.label: H2: auto-indexer appends stub to MEMORY.md for unindexed file
test_cases.command: mkdir -p /tmp/mgs_ai/.claude/projects/-Users-viresha-gokul-os/memory && echo '# Memory Index' > /tmp/mgs_ai/.claude/projects/-Users-viresha-gokul-os/memory/MEMORY.md && touch /tmp/mgs_ai/.claude/projects/-Users-viresha-gokul-os/memory/reference_zoho_mcp.md && HOME=/tmp/mgs_ai python3 ~/gokul-os/.claude/hooks/memory-gap-surface.py <<< '{}' && grep 'AUTO-INDEXED' /tmp/mgs_ai/.claude/projects/-Users-viresha-gokul-os/memory/MEMORY.md

test_cases.label: H3: surfaces COMPLETED items not found in memory files
test_cases.command: mkdir -p /tmp/mgs_h3/.claude/status /tmp/mgs_h3/.claude/memory /tmp/mgs_h3/.claude/projects/-Users-viresha-gokul-os/memory && echo '# Memory Index' > /tmp/mgs_h3/.claude/projects/-Users-viresha-gokul-os/memory/MEMORY.md && printf '## COMPLETED THIS SESSION\n- ✅ Confirmed GitLab PAT rotation deadline for 2026-09-01\n' > /tmp/mgs_h3/.claude/status/SESSION_HANDOFF.md && HOME=/tmp/mgs_h3 python3 ~/gokul-os/.claude/hooks/memory-gap-surface.py <<< '{}'
expected_stdout_contains: COMPLETED item may lack memory write

test_cases.label: H1: detects MCP resource ID in NDJSON sidecar
test_cases.command:
mkdir -p /tmp/mgs_h1/.claude/projects/-Users-viresha-gokul-os/memory /tmp/mgs_h1/.claude/scratch && echo '# Memory Index' > /tmp/mgs_h1/.claude/projects/-Users-viresha-gokul-os/memory/MEMORY.md && printf '%s
' '{"tool": "mcp__google_workspace__create_spreadsheet", "result": "{\"spreadsheetId\": \"abc123def456\", \"title\": \"Test\"}", "ts": 1234567890}' > /tmp/mgs_h1/.claude/scratch/mcp-tool-results.jsonl && HOME=/tmp/mgs_h1 python3 ~/gokul-os/.claude/hooks/memory-gap-surface.py <<< '{}'

test_cases.label: mcp-result-logger: writes valid NDJSON to sidecar for mcp__ tool
test_cases.command: mkdir -p /tmp/mgs_logger/.claude/scratch && rm -f /tmp/mgs_logger/.claude/scratch/mcp-tool-results.jsonl && python3 -c 'import json,sys; sys.stdout.write(json.dumps({"tool_name":"mcp__google_workspace__create_spreadsheet","tool_input":{},"tool_result":"{\"spreadsheetId\":\"abc123\"}"}))'  | HOME=/tmp/mgs_logger python3 ~/gokul-os/.claude/hooks/mcp-result-logger.py && python3 -c 'import json; obj=json.loads(open("/tmp/mgs_logger/.claude/scratch/mcp-tool-results.jsonl").readline()); print(obj["tool"]); assert "spreadsheetId" in obj["result"]; print("NDJSON_VALID")'
